paper.title_en: Virtual absorption modes of Schwarzschild-de Sitter spacetimes in semi-open systems
paper.abstract_en: We present a study of virtual absorption modes (VAMs) in Schwarzschild-de Sitter (SdS) spacetime under semi-open boundary conditions, where the VAMs correspond to total transmission modes (TTMs) with the reflection amplitude being vanishing. Our numerical analysis reveals that as the reflectivity $|\mathcal{K}|$ decreases, the imaginary parts of VAM spectra systematically decrease, with each overtone exhibiting a critical reflectivity at which $\text{Im}(ω_{\text{VAM}})=0$. Using simulations based on spectral collocation methods, we demonstrate that excitation precisely at a VAM spectrum leads to a virtual absorption process. These results establish VAMs as the spectral signatures of virtual absorption processes for exotic compact objects (ECOs).
